purpose: Extend support without tuning simulator parameters to observed real-domain gains.
known_limitation: The analyst already knows the historical real-domain outcomes; this seal controls new simulator and analysis degrees of freedom but cannot create temporal blinding retroactively.

frozen_simulator.rule: The data-generating process, signal strength, cluster-effect scale, feature count, classifier, train/calibration/test split, threshold selection, and reward definition remain unchanged. Only grid and output-path CLI parameters may be added.

frozen_mapping.interpolation: linear in precision and noise and log-linear in cluster count
frozen_mapping.primary_prediction: mean learned selective gain, mean margin versus no-op, and mean margin versus apply-all at each registered coordinate
frozen_mapping.categorical_selective_value: both mean margins are positive and both repeat-level win probabilities are at least 0.8
frozen_mapping.xray_sensitivity: repeat the mapping at noise 0.4, 0.6, and 0.6219512195121951; do not replace the primary coordinate based on which result agrees with reality

reveal_order: run simulator without reading observed-gain artifacts
only then join predictions to previously observed outcomes
forbidden_before_prediction_hash: changing grid after inspecting extended results
reading or joining observed real-domain gains in the prediction script
